The plate is square and about 21 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. The image is rotated.

The food is a single slice of pizza, probably a thick, focaccia-style slice with cheese and a sausage or tomato topping. It measures about 7 cm by 6 cm, which is roughly 40 cm² of footprint. At about 1.5 cm thick that is roughly 60 cm³. Bread-based pizza is fairly dense, so I estimated about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives about 40 g. I rounded up to 45 g to allow for the cheese and toppings.

The crust, cheese and topping are one slice, so I listed them as a single item.
